requirement_description: SU1.1) While ignition is off, transitions related to the power button to display splash, disclaimers, or radio last mode are based on vehicle architecture. See CFTS009 for clarification.

section_title: SU2.) For Maserati vehicles, while on the disclaimer screen the user will have access to their comfort controls. No time
requirement_title: Maserati Comfort Controls on Disclaimer Screen
requirement_description: SU2.) For Maserati vehicles, while on the disclaimer screen the user will have access to their comfort controls. No timeout is provided for Maserati applications, see CFTS009.

requirement_description: SU2.1) Do not display comfort controls on Maserati disclaimer screen when vehicle is equipped with lower comfort screen.

requirement_description: SU3.) No pop-ups will appear until the disclaimer screen has been removed. If an item like a traffic announcement is received like on this screen the user will begin hearing the announcement in the background but will not see the pop-up until the disclaimer screen is removed.

requirement_title: Shut-down Animation Duration
requirement_description: If shut-down animation is supported, the system shall begin playing it and conclude it within 10 seconds.

requirement_title: Shut-down Animation Trigger Conditions
requirement_description: The system shall begin shut-down animation only when both KEY OFF and radio UI shut down are present (not necessarily simultaneously), e.g., KEY OFF first, then radio UI shut down later in delayed mode.

section_title: DS4.1) If doors are removed/not present and ignition is turned to ACC, RUN, or START, do not show Start Up Animation and
requirement_title: Start-up Animation Skip on Door Removal
requirement_description: DS4.1) If doors are removed/not present and ignition is turned to ACC, RUN, or START, do not show Start Up Animation and jump directly to Splash screen.

requirement_title: Single Animation per CAN BUS Wake Up
requirement_description: If the ignition cycle has not changed, the system shall play the animation only once per CAN BUS wake-up upon closing the driver door.

section_title: SU5.) If ignition cycle has not changed the animation should only be played once. - Animation should only play once per
requirement_title: Animation Skip on Open Door Ignition
requirement_description: If the vehicle ignition is turned to ACC, RUN, or START ON while the driver door is open, the system shall skip the animation screen and start from the applicable splash screen.

requirement_title: Screen Behavior on Door Close (Radio OFF)
requirement_description: If the last state is Radio OFF, the system shall play startup animation and show applicable splash screens when the driver door is closed, then the system shall keep the screen black.

section_title: SU6.) If last state is Radio OFF, play startup animation and show applicable splash screens when driver door closed then
requirement_title: Animation Skip on Power Button Press
requirement_description: When the Power Button is pressed On, the system shall not show the Start Up Animation.

requirement_description: SU7.) Start up animation should sync on start up with all capable screen’s start up animation. Animations on all screens should stop (refer to logic for specific behavior) during any interruptions of animation (timeout, ignition button press).

section_title: SU8.) Show the splash screen and disclaimer screen once per CAN BUS cycle
requirement_title: Single Splash/Disclaimer per CAN BUS Cycle
requirement_description: SU8.) Show the splash screen and disclaimer screen once per CAN BUS cycle

requirement_description: SSND 1) If start-up sounds are supported, it will start upon driver door close and sync with the start-up animation. If goodbye sounds are supported, it shall sync on start with the shut-down animation. Sounds will sync amongst all supported vehicle displays.

section_title: SSND 2) Start-up and goodbye sounds shall have a setting with Always/Once a Day/Never options.
requirement_title: Start-up/Goodbye Sound Settings Options
requirement_description: SSND 2) Start-up and goodbye sounds shall have a setting with Always/Once a Day/Never options.

requirement_title: Sound Setting: Always Play
requirement_description: SSND 2.1) If the setting is Always, start-up and goodbye sounds should be played everytime the startup animation is played.

requirement_title: Sound Setting: Play Once a Day
requirement_description: SSND 2.2) If the setting is Once a Day, start-up and goodbye sounds should be played only once per day (i.e other valid triggers will not trigger any sound).

section_title: SSND 2.3) If the setting is Never, start-up and goodbye sounds should not be played on any situation.
requirement_title: Sound Setting: Never Play
requirement_description: SSND 2.3) If the setting is Never, start-up and goodbye sounds should not be played on any situation.

section_title: PM1) In the event that there are popups to show at IGN OFF but the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the
requirement_title: Head Unit Awake Time for Ignition Off Pop-ups
requirement_description: If there are popups to show at IGN OFF and the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the system shall stay awake for up to 2.5 minutes to display the popup(s). If the user does not interact with the popup within the 60-second timeout defined in the pop-up list, the system shall close the popup. If no other popups remain, the system shall shut off the radio.

section_title: PM1) In the event that there are popups to show at IGN OFF but the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the
requirement_title: Awake Time Extension on FOTA Pop-up Interaction
requirement_description: If the user interacts with the FOTA popup, the system shall stay awake until the user has not interacted with the popup for 60 seconds. The maximum time the system can stay awake due to these popups is 10 minutes.

section_title: PM1) In the event that there are popups to show at IGN OFF but the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the
requirement_title: Pop-up Priority 1: FOTA Update Available
requirement_description: For Priority 1 (FOTA update available): If the user accepts the FOTA popup, the system shall start the update and dismiss FOTA via Wi-Fi / Charge Now (if applicable). If the user schedules an update time or dismisses the update, the system shall display FOTA via Wi-Fi / Charge Now (if applicable).

section_title: PM1) In the event that there are popups to show at IGN OFF but the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the
requirement_title: Pop-up Priority 2: FOTA Wi-Fi Configuration
requirement_description: For Priority 2 (FOTA via Wi-Fi configuration): If the user chooses to configure Wi-Fi, the system shall display Charge Now (if applicable) when Wi-Fi configuration is complete. If the user chooses to dismiss the Wi-Fi configuration popup, the system shall display Charge Now (if applicable).

section_title: PM1) In the event that there are popups to show at IGN OFF but the user has set Power Accessory Delay to 0 seconds, the
requirement_title: Pop-up Priority 3: XEV Key Off Pop-ups
requirement_description: For Priority 3 (XEV key off popups: Charge Now/Summary, Preconditioning): If the user dismisses any XEV key off popup, the system shall shut down the radio.

section_title: PITA4: Screen Off and HU Power button selections shall be ignored while backup cam is being shown.

requirement_description: PITA4: Screen Off and HU Power button selections shall be ignored while backup cam is being shown.

requirement_title: Backup Camera Display in Power Off State
requirement_description: PITA5: If backup cam needs to be shown during Power Button OFF state, then it shall be shown. This shall not cancel Power Button Off state. Once the backup cam is dismissed, the Power Button Off state shall be reinstated.

requirement_title: HVAC Pop-ups Display in Power Off State
requirement_description: PITA6: HVAC pop-ups shall be temporarily displayed during Power Button Off state. Any interactions with the popups shall not cancel Power Button Off state.

requirement_description: When the ignition changes from OFF to ACC or RUN and the radio is in Power Button Off state, the system shall display HVAC popups on the screen.

requirement_title: Disclaimer Screen Display on Power On
requirement_description: When the user presses the power button to change to On state, the system shall display the disclaimer screen (see SU6.) unless certain phone call scenarios have occurred.

requirement_description: PITA8: During Key OFF (with no ACC position available), HU power ON, all headunit functionality is expected to have the same functionality as key on, except for controls that communicate with modules external to the headunit which are not functional during Key OFF.

requirement_title: Display Phone Call Popups over Power Off State
requirement_description: The system may display phone call popups while the system is in Power Button Off state.

section_title: PITA9: Phone call popups can be displayed over Power Button Off state. Ignoring a Phone call popup returns to the Power
requirement_title: Return to Power Off State on Call Ignore
requirement_description: If the user ignores a phone call popup, the system returns to Power Button Off state.

requirement_title: Return to Power Off State Post-Call
requirement_description: If the user answers a call (via soft control or hard control) and does not change screens during the phone call, the system shall return to Power Button Off state when the call ends.
